title: Inconveniences when opening a particular day
body:
Previously, it was possible to customise the calendar for myself. From a full month, clicking on a day would take me to the "schedule", which was very convenient, as I could see all the tasks at once and easily mark the ones already completed, but now, clicking on a certain day opens the "day". I've almost stopped using it because it's inconvenient to go to "schedule" every time and then go back to the month via the side menu. 

It used to remember that you opened the last "day" or "schedule" and would open that option when you clicked on the day in the month calendar. I hope you know what I mean(
